hero.title: Every child is [[smart]] in their own way
hero.text: Dr. Howard Gardner's theory of Multiple Intelligences tells us that children learn and shine in many different ways. At Smart Start The Premium School we look beyond marks and notice what makes each child unique, then nurture it through play.

how.title: How it works at Smart Start The Premium School

steps.title: Notice
steps.text: We observe how each child plays, talks, moves and creates.

steps.title: Nurture
steps.text: We offer activities that grow every strength and gently stretch the rest.

steps.title: Celebrate
steps.text: We share progress with parents and celebrate every little win.

intelligences.name: Linguistic
intelligences.heading: Word Wizards

image.alt: Boy touching an interactive alphabet sound book at his desk

intelligences.text: The love of words, stories, rhymes and conversation. Linguistic learners talk, listen and imagine in language.

intelligences.name: Logical-Mathematical
intelligences.heading: Little Problem Solvers

image.alt: Toddler playing with stacking rings and hoops on a soft play mat

intelligences.text: Curiosity about patterns, numbers and how things work. These children love sorting, counting and asking why.

intelligences.name: Spatial
intelligences.heading: Picture Thinkers

image.alt: Boy finger-painting grapes on an activity sheet

intelligences.text: Thinking in pictures, colours and shapes. Spatial learners imagine, draw and build.

intelligences.name: Bodily-Kinesthetic
intelligences.heading: Moving Mountains

image.alt: Smiling child climbing a net on a mountain-themed climbing wall

intelligences.text: Learning through movement and touch. These children climb, jump, dance and learn best when their bodies are involved.

intelligences.name: Musical
intelligences.heading: Rhythm Makers

image.alt: Children in traditional attire with a dhol at a Smart Start celebration

intelligences.text: Sensitivity to rhythm, melody and sound. Musical children hum, tap and move to the beat.

intelligences.name: Interpersonal
intelligences.heading: Friendship Builders

image.alt: Teacher seated with a group of children in blue uniforms in a themed classroom

intelligences.text: Understanding and connecting with others. These children make friends easily, share and lead.

intelligences.name: Intrapersonal
intelligences.heading: Inner Stars

image.alt: Girl pointing at an Independence Day activity worksheet at her desk

intelligences.text: Knowing one's own feelings and strengths. Intrapersonal children are thoughtful, independent and self-aware.

intelligences.name: Naturalistic
intelligences.heading: Nature Explorers

image.alt: Two children exploring a jungle-themed corner with a paper tree and a potted plant

intelligences.text: A bond with plants, animals and the natural world. These children notice, collect and care for living things.
